'''Darth Hoth Mission: Free Han (Profit)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Darth Hoth]]
* '''Published:''' 31 August 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|You Can Either Profit By This...|EJP-L-youcaneitherprofitbythis.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' You Can Either Profit By This...
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Profit Hoth LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Free Han fast with characters that have immunity to attrition and weapons.

== Strategy ==

First turn: Use Wokling to deploy I Must Be Allowed To Speak and Rycar Ryjerd to take Obi-Wan's Journal and Lightsaber Proficiency in to hand. Try to deploy enough characters to be able to free Han. Use Sai'torr Kal Fas to get the weapons out.

Subsequent turns: Spread and drain, use Han to fire his blaster during your control phase and SATM combo to fire other weapons during your control phase and add to weapon destiny. I Must Be Allowed To Speak makes Luke immune to attrition. Use the Skyhoppers to react around and then use the battle destiny adders. Deneb Both makes opponent lose force from reserve deck and Calder Righim to limit the battles. I Hope She's Alright makes opponent loss force or come to ground. MotF gets out all the sites. I think that pretty much sums everything up.

Thanks for looking, and, hopefully, reviewing.

Thanks for the review, Cam. I switched to Ben, seeing as how I have the Skyhoppers to react. 3 of the 5 teamwork interrupts work for Chewie, and those are all pullable by Chewbacca (V), so it'll be easier to set those up.
